KVKK Information Notice

This notice explains, under Article 10 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”), how your personal data is processed when you contact me through erayulusoy.com or by email. It is a translation; if it differs from the Turkish version, the Turkish version prevails.

1. Data controller

Your personal data is processed by Eray Ulusoy as data controller.

  • Address[POSTA ADRESİ / POSTAL ADDRESS]
  • Emailcontact@erayulusoy.com

2. Personal data processed

  • Identity: full name.
  • Contact: email address; if you write by email, anything in your email signature.
  • Professional: your company name (optional).
  • Enquiry: the service you are interested in and the content of your message.
  • Transaction security: IP address, browser details and time of sending, processed technically by the providers that host the site and deliver the form.

Please do not include special categories of data (such as health, religion or ethnic origin) in your message.

3. Purposes

  • Replying to your enquiry and questions,
  • Preparing a proposal and holding pre-contract discussions,
  • Entering into and performing a contract if we start working together,
  • Keeping the site and form secure and preventing spam and abuse,
  • Meeting legal obligations and protecting rights in any dispute.

4. How data is collected and legal grounds

Data is collected electronically, partly by automated means, through the contact form on this site or the emails you send. The legal grounds under KVKK Article 5(2) are:

  • (c) processing is directly related to entering into or performing a contract (proposals and pre-contract discussions),
  • (f) my legitimate interest, provided it does not harm your fundamental rights and freedoms (answering you, site security, spam prevention),
  • (ç) it is necessary to meet a legal obligation,
  • (e) it is necessary to establish, exercise or protect a right.

5. Recipients and transfers abroad

Your data is never sold or shared for marketing. It is passed only to these service providers, and only as far as the purposes above require:

  • Formspree, Inc. (USA): delivers the contact form to me by email.
  • Cloudflare, Inc. (USA, global network): hosts the site and protects it from attacks.
  • [E-POSTA SAĞLAYICISI / EMAIL PROVIDER]: hosts the mailbox for contact@erayulusoy.com.

Because these providers’ servers are outside Turkey, your data is transferred abroad under KVKK Article 9. Sending the form through Formspree relies on the explicit consent (Article 9(6)(a)) you give separately before the form is sent. The Turkish Personal Data Protection Board has not issued an adequacy decision for these countries, so your data may not be protected to the same standard as in Turkey and may be accessible to authorities there. If you would rather not consent, you can skip the form and write directly to contact@erayulusoy.com.

Data may also be disclosed to authorised public bodies, only where the law requires it and only as far as necessary.

6. Retention

Your data is kept until your enquiry is concluded and for at most 2 years after that. If we work together, contract and invoice records are kept for the periods set by Turkish law (for example the Commercial Code and the Tax Procedure Law). Copies held in the Formspree account are deleted at least every 6 months. Data past its retention period is deleted or anonymised.

7. Your rights under KVKK Article 11

You may apply to the data controller to:

  • learn whether your personal data is processed,
  • request information about the processing,
  • learn the purpose of processing and whether data is used accordingly,
  • know the third parties in Turkey or abroad to whom data is transferred,
  • request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data,
  • request deletion or destruction under the conditions in KVKK Article 7,
  • request that third parties who received the data are notified of any correction, deletion or destruction,
  • object to a result against you arising solely from automated analysis,
  • claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.

You can withdraw your explicit consent at any time; this does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.

8. How to apply

Send your request, in line with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller, in writing to the address above, by registered electronic mail (KEP), secure electronic or mobile signature, or by email to contact@erayulusoy.com from an email address you have previously given me. Please include your full name, Turkish ID number (or nationality and passport/ID number for foreign nationals), postal address, email address if any, and your request.

Requests are answered free of charge within 30 days; if the request involves an additional cost, the fee set by the Board may be charged. If your request is refused, you find the answer insufficient, or it is not answered in time, you may complain to the Turkish Personal Data Protection Board.

For how the site handles data in general, see the Privacy Policy.
